purpose: Real-GPU reading-key exemplars, not live data or screenshot acceptance evidence.
instructions: Run each non-pending slot's capture command serially through outputs/cap.sh. --clip affects the burst crop only: the file consumed below is the -burst-00.png, never the full-frame PNG. Re-capture every supplied file; old files at these paths do not certify the corrected rectangles.

These rectangles are derived from the current production projection and canonical field, not verified GPU crops. Before publishing, inspect each new burst crop against RISK_SURFACE_SIGNATURES and its derivation. Confirm identifiable mirror/pair/triple/silt, with no hull, pier, sign, shoreline or seam; otherwise set file to null and supply an explicit pending reason. Do not publish a misidentified crop.

Watch, Danger, Ledger and Wreck remain explicitly pending in mixed-capacity at this overview. Alternative-fixture completionPath entries are analysis, not supplied crops or passed GPU gates; do not promote them without capturing and inspecting those signatures. The operator's real-GPU Wreck review rejected the datum-field candidate because rendered bank, roof and dock cover it.

Only STEADY and CRISIS lighthouse states have official readings in the requested fixtures. Other PSI image slots remain absent until a matching official fixture is supplied. sky=BAND changes cloud/air appearance only, not official PSI or beacon state.

After S4-P5 lands, run the cloud command and change its file from null to outputs/g/reading/cloud-burst-00.png, removing pending only after visual review. Re-run all affected shader/silhouette captures after appearance changes.

Then run node scripts/pharosville/generate-reading-atlas.mjs --manifest agents/2026-10-05-garden-levers/destination/reading-atlas-crops.json. It publishes public/garden-reading-atlas.webp and src/systems/reading-atlas.json; pending slots have no exemplar or source, and stay text-only in the key.
Review key-day/key-night at 1200x640 and 900x720, in reduced motion and grayscale, then run the S3 blinded reading protocol. This manifest does not claim those gates passed.

overview.boundsMeaning: Approximate [minX,minY,maxX,maxY] on a 4 CSS-pixel grid, not rectangles to crop
method: Build the fixture world and selectGardenObservatorySlice(world,null). Clamp the URL rig through clampCameraToMap using the actual 140x140 map and 1600x1000 viewport; cam offsets are iso-pose pixels, not tile coordinates. Reduced motion removes breath and hull animation.

Build the renderer's 512x512 sea-region field. For each screen pixel, screenToGround(pixel,camera,viewport,-1.45) intersects the datum. Sample R at floor(tile/140*512), matching the categorical renderer field; G*6.5 and B*24 recover boundary and shore distances. Water-local coordinates for the signature are (tileX*sqrt(2),-tileY*sqrt(2)), not (X,+Z).

Resolve each representative's reduced-motion tile with resolveGardenShipDisplayTile using sample={tile:ship.riskTile,state:'idle'}. Project writeGardenFleetFootprint at headingRad=-gardenRepresentativeRestHeading(world,id); exclude its hull/sail union bounding rectangle plus 7 CSS pixels. This is a conservative geometry envelope, not a rendered-pixel occlusion proof.

Project each displayed dock's stationFootprintRect corners over world Y [-1.25,18], with 5 CSS pixels of padding; this deliberately covers piers, massing and nobori. Exclude all seaSignSteles at world Y 4 with a conservative screen rectangle of +/-25 X and +/-20 Y. Shore distance >=4 tiles excludes coastline; field purity excludes land and region seams.

Search 4px-grid rectangles, descending widths [160,144,128,112,96,80,64,48], height rounded to a 1.6 aspect. Prefer high boundary/shore-distance centres. Inset the final Calm and Warning edges beyond subpixel obstacle bounds. Per-pixel field purity is recorded per slot; field/geometry classification is not GPU acceptance.

For stroke slots, apply the static gardenRiskSurface cell/rotation/jitter/group equations to the inverse-projected water coordinates. Use 1px ray differences for footprint; identify a complete pair/triple/quartet rather than a blank cell. JS double-precision gardenHash is only a location sanity check: GLSL floating-point hashes, wave displacement, optical light, contact and actual GPU legibility must be reviewed in the new captures.

lighthouse.method: Use defaultCamera({width:1600,height:1000,map}) with rest presence 1, not the bare rig. gardenTowerWorldAnchors(LIGHTHOUSE_TILE) includes gardenIslandDisplayTile's (12,8) tile offset and root (-7,8.55,-1.25). Project foot, beacon and crown with worldToScreen. Both fixtures share this geometry; quiet-dense supplies official STEADY/82, mixed-capacity CRISIS/25.
lighthouse.reason: Old y=150 excluded the sceptre crown at y=140. New y=100 includes crown and lantern with margin; x=900..1100 and y=100..525 include the tower's body and foot.

sails.method: Build denseQuietArtInput and selectGardenObservatorySlice(world,null); find each named representative without selecting it. Resolve reduced-motion display tiles and selection-independent rest headings. Use USDT's reference tile (49,97) and camera (1676.921606,-961.6,0.8). For each other hull delta=(dx,dy) from that tile, translate camera offsets by (-16*0.8*(dx-dy),-8*0.8*(dx+dy)); clamp the resulting camera as production does. This translates the full camera view with the hull, not just its screen X: all three retain exactly the same eye-to-root distance and root screen position. No sel parameter: it paints a world-space selection label over the cloth. Project writeGardenFleetFootprint's identitySail and hull/sail envelopes for the unselected slice. Use the same [804,466,64,72] crop for all three: it contains all three cloth envelopes and hull/sail unions, centred on the common hull X, with little contextual margin. Equal dimensions give equal atlas resize scale, unlike the rejected individually sized tight crops.
